title: the opening deposit of the discriminating daily savings account (id 2) credits the posted balance from zero to 100000 minor (1000.00 MNT)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture savings-account-daily-raw.json (GET account read-back, tenant gerege). request.transaction_stream.transactions[0] is the account's opening DEPOSIT row (transaction id 4, transactionType.id 1, amount 1000.000000, entryType CREDIT, dated 2026-08-31), transcribed as type_id 1 and amount_minor "100000". expect.running_balances[0]="100000" is the integer minor-unit form of the runningBalance 1000.000000 the read-back recorded on that row, the account's FIRST row, so the fold starts from a zero opening balance. The seam does not read the recorded running_balance column; it derives the fold over the observed row and pins the observed value. A port that fails to CREDIT the deposit (leaves the opening balance at zero or less), that scales or signs the amount wrongly, or that starts the fold from a nonzero opening balance goes red here. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
